name: Deep-Fried Shredded Beef Chimichanga with Queso
whyItWorks: A giant flour tortilla wrapped around spiced beef, deep-fried until blistered and submerged in heavy melted queso dip, packs intense oil, dairy, and spices that aggressively irritate the digestive tract.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Extreme Danger Warning: Avoid during flares or active gut inflammation. Order a soft baked enchilada or grilled street taco instead.
